In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED), creiamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità.

All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo di asset End-to-End attraverso l'intera catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto del mercato. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani.

Come leader di progetto DMPK-PD esperto all'interno del Dipartimento DMPK-PD Traduzionale, sarete fondamentali per garantire che il farmaco giusto viene consegnato alla dose giusta, in modo sicuro ed efficace ai pazienti. Condurrai strategie non cliniche e traduttive, collaborando in aree terapeutiche per trasformare le ipotesi scientifiche in candidati clinici innovativi.

I vostri impatti e responsabilità:

• Leadership strategica: Definire e condurre la progettazione avanzata della droga, strategie di ottimizzazione e profilazione completa dei composti, integrando i principi DMPK all'avanguardia con la convalida della biologia di destinazione e concetti di PK/PD traduttivi complessi.

• Esperienza traduttiva: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, guidare i team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di sofisticate strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione target, sfruttando la conoscenza biochimica e farmacologica profonda.

• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): attività M&S avanzate dirette (comprese PKPD complessi, PBPK, DDI e sofisticate predizioni dose/regimen umane) per informare criticamente e de-rischiare i progetti da Lead Optimisation (LO) attraverso lo sviluppo clinico precoce e di fine fase (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Mastery di regolamentazione: Autore e presente valutazioni scientifiche definitive e di alta qualità dei dati DMPK non clinici per le recensioni critiche dei programmi interni e tutte le principali sottomissioni normative esterne (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assicurando la conformità globale e tempi accelerati.

• Attuazione e innovazione: Pioneer e supervisionare l'implementazione di robuste strategie biomarcatrici e bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con le principali parti interessate per massimizzare la sicurezza dei pazienti e il beneficio terapeutico.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion trasparente, data-driven decision-making, agendo come consulente affidabile e coltivando relazioni professionali di alta fiducia in team di progetto globali, enti di governance e partnership esterne.

Chi sei

• Hai un PharmD o un PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia, Bioingegneria o simili, accoppiato con oltre 15 - 20 anni di esperienza post-PhD nell'industria progressiva in un ruolo legato alla farmacocinetica senior.

• Possiedi una profonda e completa esperienza in tutto lo spettro di scoperta, preclinica e di sviluppo, che copre la caratterizzazione PK, la distribuzione e PKPD per diverse modalità (piccole molecole, biologiche, terapeutiche nuove), fondate in autorevole conoscenza della farmacologia e della fisiologia.

• Lei dimostra la padronanza di piattaforme di modellazione e simulazione avanzate (ad esempio, Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) e possiede esperienza pratica o un forte sforzo per applicare le metodologie Artificial Intelligence (AI) e Machine Learning (ML) per evolvere le strategie DMPK.

• Unisci una straordinaria comprensione PK/PD con una comunicazione eccezionale, una negoziazione e una comprovata esperienza di leadership senior, in grado di guidare progetti altamente complessi e multidisciplinari.

• Sei pienamente responsabile per la definizione di risultati strategici, assicurando la consegna di esperti, e abilmente navigare e risolvere problemi critici attraverso confini organizzativi e geografici.

• Sei un leader inclusivo e autentico che sostiene la diversità, colleghi mentori, e promuove attivamente un ambiente ad alta fiducia, ad alte prestazioni in cui ogni membro del team è abilitato a contribuire al meglio.

A Roche, ci proponiamo di offrire soluzioni sanitarie in continuo cambiamento. Se siete pronti a fare un impatto significativo su pazienti e sistemi sanitari in tutto il mondo, questo è il posto per voi.

Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione.
Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive End-to-End asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Department, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates.

Your Impact & Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Define and lead advanced drug design, optimisation strategies, and comprehensive compound profiling, integrating cutting-edge DMPK principles with target biology validation and complex translational PK/PD concepts.

• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.

• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Direct advanced M&S activities (including complex PKPD, PBPK, DDI, and sophisticated human dose/regimen prediction) to critically inform and de-risk projects from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early and late-stage clinical development (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.

• Implementation & Innovation: Pioneer and oversee the implementation of robust biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close partnership with key stakeholders to maximise patient safety and therapeutic benefit.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships.

Who You Are

• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering or similar, coupled with over 15 - 20 years of post-PhD progressive industry experience in a senior pharmacokinetic-related role.

• You possess deep, comprehensive expertise across the entire discovery, preclinical and development spectrum, covering PK characterisation, distribution, and PKPD for diverse modalities (small molecules, biologics, novel therapeutics), grounded in authoritative knowledge of pharmacology and physiology.

• You demonstrate mastery of advanced modelling and simulation platforms (e.g., Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) and possess practical experience or a strong drive to apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) methodologies to evolve DMPK strategies.

• You combine exceptional PK/PD understanding with outstanding communication, negotiation, and proven senior leadership experience, adept at guiding highly complex, multi-disciplinary projects.

• You are fully accountable for defining strategic outcomes, ensuring expert delivery, and skillfully navigating and resolving critical issues across organisational and geographical boundaries.

• You are an inclusive, authentic leader who champions diversity, mentors colleagues, and actively fosters a high-trust, high-performance environment where every team member is empowered to contribute their best.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
In Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organisation (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der weltweit härtesten unerfüllten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED verbindet uns unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Mitarbeiter befähigt und inspiriert werden, außergewöhnliche, lebensverändernde Innovationen in kürzester Zeit hervorzubringen.

An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Bevölkerungsgruppen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen.

Die Chance

Als erfahrener DMPK-PD-Projektleiter in der Translationalen DMPK-PD-Abteilung sind Sie von entscheidender Bedeutung, um sicherzustellen, dass das richtige Medikament in der richtigen Dosis sicher und wirksam an Patienten abgegeben wird. Sie werden nichtklinische und translationale Strategien leiten und in therapeutischen Bereichen zusammenarbeiten, um wissenschaftliche Hypothesen in bahnbrechende klinische Kandidaten umzuwandeln.

Ihre Auswirkungen und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Strategische Führung: Definieren und führen Sie fortschrittliches Arzneimitteldesign, Optimierungsstrategien und umfassendes Compound-Profiling, Integration modernster DMPK-Prinzipien mit Zielbiologievalidierung und komplexen translationalen PK / PD-Konzepten.

• Translationale Expertise: Dienen Sie als Fachexperte und leiten Sie frühe Entdeckungsteams bei der Entwicklung anspruchsvoller translationaler Strategien für die klinische Bewertung der Zielmodulation und nutzen Sie tiefe biochemische und pharmakologische Kenntnisse.

• Fortgeschrittene Modellierung und Simulation (M&S): Direkte fortgeschrittene M&S-Aktivitäten (einschließlich komplexer PKPD, PBPK, DDI und ausgefeilter Vorhersage der menschlichen Dosis/Therapie), um Projekte aus der Lead-Optimierung (LO) im frühen und späten Stadium der klinischen Entwicklung kritisch zu informieren und zu de-riskieren (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Regulatory Mastery: Autor und Präsentiert endgültige, qualitativ hochwertige wissenschaftliche Bewertungen von nicht-klinischen DMPK-Daten für kritische interne Programmüberprüfungen und alle wichtigen externen regulatorischen Einreichungen (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), die globale Compliance und beschleunigte Zeitpläne gewährleisten.

• Implementierung & Innovation: Pionierarbeit und Überwachung der Umsetzung robuster Biomarker- und bioanalytischer Strategien in enger Partnerschaft mit wichtigen Interessengruppen zur Maximierung der Patientensicherheit und des therapeutischen Nutzens.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparente, datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung, als vertrauenswürdiger Berater fungieren und vertrauensvolle professionelle Beziehungen zwischen globalen Projektteams, Governance-Gremien und externen Partnerschaften pflegen.

Wer du bist

• Sie haben eine PharmD oder PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering oder ähnlichem, gepaart mit über 15 - 20 Jahren Post-PhD progressive Industrieerfahrung in einer leitenden pharmakokinetischen Rolle.

• Sie verfügen über ein umfassendes Fachwissen über das gesamte Entdeckungs-, präklinische und Entwicklungsspektrum, das die Charakterisierung, Verteilung und PKPD für verschiedene Modalitäten (kleine Moleküle, Biologika, neuartige Therapeutika) abdeckt und auf maßgeblichen Kenntnissen der Pharmakologie und Physiologie basiert.

• Sie demonstrieren die Beherrschung fortschrittlicher Modellierungs- und Simulationsplattformen (z. B. Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) und verfügen über praktische Erfahrung oder einen starken Antrieb, um Methoden der künstlichen Intelligenz (KI) und des maschinellen Lernens (ML) anzuwenden, um DMPK-Strategien zu entwickeln.

• Sie kombinieren außergewöhnliches PK / PD-Verständnis mit hervorragender Kommunikation, Verhandlung und bewährter Führungserfahrung, die in der Leitung hochkomplexer, multidisziplinärer Projekte kompetent sind.

• Sie sind in vollem Umfang dafür verantwortlich, strategische Ergebnisse zu definieren, die Bereitstellung von Experten sicherzustellen und kritische Probleme über organisatorische und geografische Grenzen hinweg geschickt zu navigieren und zu lösen.

• Sie sind eine integrative, authentische Führungskraft, die sich für Vielfalt einsetzt, Kollegen betreut und aktiv eine vertrauensvolle, leistungsstarke Umgebung fördert, in der jedes Teammitglied sein Bestes geben kann.

Bei Roche streben wir nach lebensverändernden Gesundheitslösungen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf Patienten und Gesundheitssysteme weltweit zu machen, ist dies der richtige Ort für Sie.

Wenn Lohntransparenz gilt, werden die Angaben auf der Grundlage des primären Entsendeortes angegeben. Für diese Rolle ist der Hauptstandort Basel. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle möglicherweise verfügbar ist, werden wir Ihnen die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess mitteilen.
Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie.

A l'intersection de la science et de l'innovation, l'organisation des sciences pharmaceutiques (PS) permet de découvrir et de développer des thérapies sûres et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées avec une vision de la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. En intégrant de façon transparente nos trois piliers principaux — Sécurité, pharmacologie translationnelle et biomarqueurs — nous aidons le développement d'actifs de bout en bout dans toute la chaîne de valeur, de l'évaluation des cibles au soutien sur le marché. Notre mission est d'améliorer en permanence la précision prédictive, d'optimiser les stratégies de dosage pour les bonnes populations de patients et d'accélérer le développement des traitements sûrs et efficaces de demain.

L'opportunité

En tant que chef de projet expérimenté de la DMPK-PD au sein du département de la DMPK-PD translationnel, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour vous assurer que le bon médicament est livré à la bonne dose, en toute sécurité et efficacement aux patients. Vous dirigerez des stratégies non cliniques et translationnelles, en collaborant dans des domaines thérapeutiques pour transformer des hypothèses scientifiques en candidats cliniques révolutionnaires.

Votre impact et vos responsabilités :

• Leadership stratégique: Définir et diriger la conception avancée de médicaments, les stratégies d'optimisation et le profilage complet des composés, en intégrant les principes de pointe de DMPK avec la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts de PK/PD translationnels complexes.

• Expertise translationnelle : servir d'expert en la matière, guider les équipes de découverte précoce dans l'élaboration de stratégies translationnelles sophistiquées pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible, en tirant parti de connaissances biochimiques et pharmacologiques profondes.

• Modélisation et simulation avancées (M&S) : Diriger les activités de M&S avancées (y compris la PKPD complexe, la PBPK, l'IDD et la prédiction sophistiquée des doses/régimes humains) afin d'informer de façon critique les projets d'optimisation du plomb et de les éliminer jusqu'au développement clinique en début et en fin de développement (EIH, Ph 2/3).

• Maîtrise de la réglementation : Auteur et présentation d'évaluations scientifiques définitives de haute qualité des données DMPK non cliniques pour les examens internes critiques des programmes et toutes les principales présentations de réglementation externe (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assurant la conformité mondiale et des délais accélérés.

• Implementation & Innovation: Pioneer et superviser la mise en œuvre de stratégies biomarqueurs et bioanalytiques robustes en partenariat étroit avec les principales parties prenantes afin de maximiser la sécurité des patients et les avantages thérapeutiques.

• Influence interfonctionnelle : Championne, prise de décision transparente et axée sur les données, agissant comme conseiller de confiance et cultivant des relations professionnelles de haute confiance entre les équipes de projet mondiales, les organismes de gouvernance et les partenariats externes.

Qui vous êtes

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie, bioingénierie ou similaire, associé à plus de 15 à 20 années d'expérience de l'industrie progressive post-PhD dans un rôle pharmacocinétique supérieur.

• Vous possédez une expertise approfondie et complète sur l'ensemble du spectre de découverte, préclinique et de développement, couvrant la caractérisation, la distribution et la PKPD de PKK pour diverses modalités (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouveaux traitements), basées sur une connaissance autorisée de la pharmacologie et de la physiologie.

• Vous démontrez la maîtrise des plates-formes de modélisation et de simulation avancées (p. ex. Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) et vous possédez une expérience pratique ou un puissant effort pour appliquer des méthodologies d'intelligence artificielle (AI) et d'apprentissage automatique (ML) pour développer des stratégies DMPK.

• Vous combinez une compréhension exceptionnelle de la PK/PD avec une expérience exceptionnelle en communication, en négociation et en leadership de haut niveau éprouvée, et vous guidez des projets multidisciplinaires très complexes.

• Vous êtes pleinement responsable de la définition des résultats stratégiques, de la prestation des services d'experts, de la navigation et de la résolution des problèmes critiques au-delà des frontières organisationnelles et géographiques.

• Vous êtes un leader inclusif et authentique qui défend la diversité, mentore les collègues et favorise activement un environnement de haute confiance et de haute performance où chaque membre de l'équipe est habilité à apporter son meilleur.

Chez Roche, nous nous efforçons de fournir des solutions de soins de santé qui changent la vie. Si vous êtes prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur les patients et les systèmes de santé dans le monde, c'est l'endroit pour vous.

Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche.
Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

In the cardiovascular and metabolism area, we are developing cutting-edge therapies to treat metabolic diseases.

We are currently looking for a diligent and highly motivated Research Associate with a strong industry background to join our Cardiovascular and Metabolic Diseases (CVM) in-vivo pharmacology department . In this role, you will design and execute in-vivo experiments in rodents to evaluate the pharmacodynamics, efficacy and safety of novel therapeutic candidates for cardiovascular and metabolic diseases.

• Establish, validate and use disease relevant rodent models (e.g., obesity and diabetes) and readouts to support various drug discovery projects.

• Collaboratively design and execute in-vivo studies, and interpret data from in-vivo experiments to assess the pharmacodynamics and therapeutic efficacy of novel compounds.

• Support the development and characterization of novel in-vivo models for obesity-related comorbidities.

• Diligently follow national and international animal welfare laws, and align with the company's commitment to the 3Rs (Replace, Reduce, Refine).

• Continuously improve test systems, analyses, and data evaluation. Contribute to work process optimization including data capture, storage and assay automation.

• Work closely with all members of the group, share duties, maintain a clean work environment and actively contribute to the positive work atmosphere within the group.

• MSc/BSc in Life Sciences or completion of an apprenticeship for a research associate (“Lehrabschluss”)(no PhD) with at least 3 years of industry experience working with in-vivo models.

• Mouse work experience required; managing animal cohorts, injections via various routes, behavioral assays, mouse monitoring, tissue sampling and processing.

• LTK1 or equivalent is required.

• Experience in rodent models of obesity and functional readouts, such as glucose and insulin tolerance tests, body composition analysis, whole-body metabolism (Promethion), blood pressure.

• You communicate effectively in English, both in writing and orally. Skillfully able to interact with people and have strong commitment to teamwork.

• Excellent data management and record-keeping skills are required.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), located in Basel, Switzerland, focuses on the discovery and early development of innovative treatments for specific diseases that affect the lives of millions. In the cardiovascular and metabolism area, we are developing cutting-edge therapies to treat metabolic diseases.

We are currently looking for a diligent and highly motivated Research Associate with a strong industry background to join our Cardiovascular and Metabolic Diseases (CVM) in-vivo pharmacology department . In this role, you will design and execute in-vivo experiments in rodents to evaluate the pharmacodynamics, efficacy and safety of novel therapeutic candidates for cardiovascular and metabolic diseases.

The opportunity

• Establish, validate and use disease relevant rodent models (e.g., obesity and diabetes) and readouts to support various drug discovery projects.

• Collaboratively design and execute in-vivo studies, and interpret data from in-vivo experiments to assess the pharmacodynamics and therapeutic efficacy of novel compounds.

• Support the development and characterization of novel in-vivo models for obesity-related comorbidities.

• Diligently follow national and international animal welfare laws, and align with the company's commitment to the 3Rs (Replace, Reduce, Refine).

• Continuously improve test systems, analyses, and data evaluation. Contribute to work process optimization including data capture, storage and assay automation.

• Work closely with all members of the group, share duties, maintain a clean work environment and actively contribute to the positive work atmosphere within the group.

Who You Are

• MSc/BSc in Life Sciences or completion of an apprenticeship for a research associate (“Lehrabschluss”)(no PhD) with at least 3 years of industry experience working with in-vivo models.

• Mouse work experience required; managing animal cohorts, injections via various routes, behavioral assays, mouse monitoring, tissue sampling and processing.

• LTK1 or equivalent is required.

• Experience in rodent models of obesity and functional readouts, such as glucose and insulin tolerance tests, body composition analysis, whole-body metabolism (Promethion), blood pressure.

• You communicate effectively in English, both in writing and orally. Skillfully able to interact with people and have strong commitment to teamwork.

• Excellent data management and record-keeping skills are required.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Global Technical Development (PTD) is an organization of over two thousand people globally that are integral for the mission of Roche to develop meaningful medicines for patients. Therefore, we actively collaborate and develop creative technical solutions to bridge early-stage, late-stage and commercial product needs. The mandate is to expertly deliver the pipeline and supply quality products to patients.

The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

Device Engineering combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:

This hands-on role drives engineering excellence by applying design controls, solving complex device engineering challenges, and providing strategic technical guidance to ensure robust product development and compliance.
In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.

• Serve as technical lead and subject matter expert to bring combination products and medical devices from development to market.

• Apply deep expertise in primary container materials (Type I glass, COP/COC polymers, elastomers, functional coatings) and extractables/leachables (E&L) profiles to establish robust technical specifications for primary packaging systems.

• Develop and evaluate container closure design solutions to ensure seamless device integration, container integrity, fill/finish expertise and sustained technical performance.

• External Technical Oversight: Collaborate with external partners providing technical oversight on mechanical designs for combination products to ensure high performance, design robustness and innovation.

• Structured Problem Solving & RCA: Lead internal and external technical investigations, swiftly resolve design-related device and primary container issues (e.g., break-loose/glide force, glass damage mechanisms, sub-visible particles, stopper movement) by applying structured problem solving methodologies.

• Design Control & Regulatory Authoring: Author design control documentation (e.g. Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.

• Standards & Compliance Application: Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820, ISO 14971, 21 CFR 820.30, 21 CFR Part 4, ISO 11040, ISO 11608, USP <1207> / USP <381> / USP <660>).

Who you are:

• University degree (BSc or MSc) in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

• 5+ years of experience in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development within pharma or highly regulated environments (cGxP, QSR).

• Strong expertise in container closure systems, specifically prefilled syringes (PFS) and cartridges for parenteral drug delivery (including CCI testing, elastomer/coating chemistry, staked-needle integration, and dimensional stack-ups).

• Experience in fill / finish technology incl. stoppering

• Proven technical leadership and advanced problem-solving capabilities in cross-functional team environments.

• Solid understanding of materials science applied to drug delivery systems, with expertise in damage mechanisms, defect identification, and performance testing.

• Deep knowledge of regulations, industry standards, and guidance for combination products and medical devices on a global scale.

• Direct experience navigating Health Authority interactions and managing regulatory submissions (including Module 3 authoring for IND/IMPD and NDA/BLA).

• Technical proficiency in parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, and reliability engineering to resolve complex issues.

• Excellent communication skills, strategic thinking, and strong documentation/presentation capabilities to effectively influence stakeholders.

• Fluency in English is required for this global role; German proficiency is a plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. La posizione

Pertanto, collaboriamo attivamente e sviluppiamo soluzioni tecniche creative per colmare le esigenze dei prodotti in fase iniziale, di fine fase e commerciale. Le nostre attività abbracciano una gamma di discipline ingegneristiche dalla fase di definizione dei requisiti fino alla commercializzazione e al supporto dei prodotti commercializzati.

L'ingegneria dei dispositivi combina progettazione, ingegneria, test e produzione per sviluppare dispositivi di consegna affidabili e sicuri della droga che soddisfano le esigenze dei pazienti, fornitori di assistenza sanitaria e autorità sanitarie.

L'opportunità:

Questo ruolo pratico guida l'eccellenza ingegneristica applicando i controlli di progettazione, risolvendo complesse sfide di ingegneria dei dispositivi, e fornendo una guida tecnica strategica per garantire uno sviluppo e una conformità robusti del prodotto.
In questo ruolo, vi impegnate in una vasta collaborazione interfunzionale, in particolare con i team di Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical e Commercial. Questo ruolo riporta alla Sezione Capo di Ingegneria dei dispositivi ed è integrato nella funzione Roche Device Development.

• Servire come lead tecnico e soggetto esperto di materia per portare prodotti combinati e dispositivi medici dallo sviluppo al mercato.

• Applicare una profonda esperienza nei materiali per container primari (Type I glass, COP/COC polimeri, elastomeri, rivestimenti funzionali) e profili estraibile/leachables (E&L) per stabilire solide specifiche tecniche per i sistemi di imballaggio primari.

• Sviluppare e valutare soluzioni di progettazione di chiusura dei container per garantire l'integrazione dei dispositivi senza soluzione di continuità, l'integrità dei container, la competenza di riempimento/finish e le prestazioni tecniche sostenute.

• Supervisione tecnica esterna: Collabora con partner esterni che forniscono una supervisione tecnica sui progetti meccanici per prodotti combinati per garantire elevate prestazioni, robustezza progettuale e innovazione.

• Strutturato Problem Solving & RCA: condurre indagini tecniche interne ed esterne, risolvere rapidamente i problemi relativi al dispositivo di progettazione e dei container primari (ad esempio, forza di rottura/scivolo, meccanismi di danneggiamento del vetro, particelle sub-visibili, movimento di fermo) applicando metodologie strutturate di problem solving.

• Autorizzazione: Documentazione di controllo della progettazione dell'autore (ad esempio Piani di sviluppo di progettazione, Specifiche dei requisiti dell'utente, Input di progettazione, uscite di progettazione, piani di verifica di progettazione), valutazioni di conformità e documentazione di gestione del rischio.

• Standards & Compliance Applicazione: Applicare la conoscenza del paesaggio normativo per garantire disegni conformi standard (ad esempio ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820, ISO 14971, 21 CFR 820.30, 21 CFR Parte 4, ISO 11040, ISO 11608, USP <1207> / USP <381> / USP <660>).

Chi sei:

• Laurea universitaria (BSc o MSc) in ingegneria o una disciplina tecnica correlata da un istituto accreditato.

• 5+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di dispositivi di ingegneria meccanica e di distribuzione di farmaci in ambienti farmacologici o altamente regolamentati (cGxP, QSR).

• Forte competenza nei sistemi di chiusura dei container, in particolare siringhe preriempite (PFS) e cartucce per la somministrazione di farmaci parenterali (compreso test CCI, elastomeri/cottura chimica, integrazione di scarto-needle e stack-up dimensionali).

• Esperienza nella tecnologia di riempimento / finitura incl. stoppering

• Prova leadership tecnica e capacità avanzate di problem solving in ambienti di team interfunzionali.

• Solida comprensione della scienza dei materiali applicata ai sistemi di consegna della droga, con competenza nei meccanismi di danno, identificazione del difetto e test delle prestazioni.

• Conoscenza profonda delle normative, degli standard industriali e della guida per prodotti combinati e dispositivi medici su scala globale.

Chi siamo

Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Global Technical Development (PTD) is an organization of over two thousand people globally that are integral for the mission of Roche to develop meaningful medicines for patients. Therefore, we actively collaborate and develop creative technical solutions to bridge early-stage, late-stage and commercial product needs. The mandate is to expertly deliver the pipeline and supply quality products to patients.

The Device Development department within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.

Device Engineering combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The opportunity:

This hands-on role drives engineering excellence by applying design controls, solving complex device engineering challenges, and providing strategic technical guidance to ensure robust product development and compliance.
In this role, you will engage in extensive cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial teams. This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into the Roche Device Development function.

• Serve as technical lead and subject matter expert to bring combination products and medical devices from development to market.

• Apply deep expertise in primary container materials (Type I glass, COP/COC polymers, elastomers, functional coatings) and extractables/leachables (E&L) profiles to establish robust technical specifications for primary packaging systems.

• Develop and evaluate container closure design solutions to ensure seamless device integration, container integrity, fill/finish expertise and sustained technical performance.

• External Technical Oversight: Collaborate with external partners providing technical oversight on mechanical designs for combination products to ensure high performance, design robustness and innovation.

• Structured Problem Solving & RCA: Lead internal and external technical investigations, swiftly resolve design-related device and primary container issues (e.g., break-loose/glide force, glass damage mechanisms, sub-visible particles, stopper movement) by applying structured problem solving methodologies.

• Design Control & Regulatory Authoring: Author design control documentation (e.g. Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans), conformity assessments and risk management documentation.

• Standards & Compliance Application: Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g. ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820, ISO 14971, 21 CFR 820.30, 21 CFR Part 4, ISO 11040, ISO 11608, USP <1207> / USP <381> / USP <660>).

Who you are:

• University degree (BSc or MSc) in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

• 5+ years of experience in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development within pharma or highly regulated environments (cGxP, QSR).

• Strong expertise in container closure systems, specifically prefilled syringes (PFS) and cartridges for parenteral drug delivery (including CCI testing, elastomer/coating chemistry, staked-needle integration, and dimensional stack-ups).

• Experience in fill / finish technology incl. stoppering

• Proven technical leadership and advanced problem-solving capabilities in cross-functional team environments.

• Solid understanding of materials science applied to drug delivery systems, with expertise in damage mechanisms, defect identification, and performance testing.

• Deep knowledge of regulations, industry standards, and guidance for combination products and medical devices on a global scale.

• Direct experience navigating Health Authority interactions and managing regulatory submissions (including Module 3 authoring for IND/IMPD and NDA/BLA).

• Technical proficiency in parenteral drug delivery, risk assessment, tolerance analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, and reliability engineering to resolve complex issues.

• Excellent communication skills, strategic thinking, and strong documentation/presentation capabilities to effectively influence stakeholders.

• Fluency in English is required for this global role; German proficiency is a plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Global Technical Development (PTD) ist eine Organisation von über zweitausend Menschen weltweit, die für die Mission von Roche, sinnvolle Medikamente für Patienten zu entwickeln, von wesentlicher Bedeutung sind. Daher arbeiten wir aktiv zusammen und entwickeln kreative technische Lösungen, um die Bedürfnisse von Früh-, Spät- und kommerziellen Produkten zu überbrücken. Das Mandat besteht darin, die Pipeline fachgerecht zu liefern und Qualitätsprodukte an Patienten zu liefern.

Die Abteilung Geräteentwicklung innerhalb von Roche Technical Development ist für die Entwicklung und den Support von Medikamentenabgabegeräten für das Produktportfolio verantwortlich. Unsere Aktivitäten umfassen eine Reihe von Engineering-Disziplinen von der Phase der Anforderungsdefinition bis hin zur Kommerzialisierung und Vermarktung von Produktsupport.

Device Engineering kombiniert Design, Engineering, Testen und Fertigung, um zuverlässige und sichere Arzneimittelabgabegeräte zu entwickeln, die den Bedürfnissen von Patienten, Gesundheitsdienstleistern und Gesundheitsbehörden entsprechen.

Die Gelegenheit:

Diese praktische Rolle fördert die technische Exzellenz durch die Anwendung von Designkontrollen, die Lösung komplexer Herausforderungen bei der Gerätetechnik und die Bereitstellung strategischer technischer Leitlinien, um eine robuste Produktentwicklung und Compliance sicherzustellen.
In dieser Rolle werden Sie in einer umfassenden funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit tätig sein, insbesondere mit Qualitätssicherungs-, Regulierungs-, klinischen und kommerziellen Teams. Diese Rolle berichtet an den Sektionsleiter Device Engineering und ist in die Funktion Roche Device Development integriert.

• Als technischer Leiter und Fachexperte bringen Sie Kombinationsprodukte und Medizinprodukte aus der Entwicklung auf den Markt.

• Wenden Sie fundiertes Know-how in Primärbehältermaterialien (Typ I-Glas, COP / COC-Polymere, Elastomere, funktionelle Beschichtungen) und Extrahier- / Laugungsprofile (E & L) an, um robuste technische Spezifikationen für Primärverpackungssysteme zu erstellen.

• Entwickeln und bewerten Sie Lösungen für das Containerverschlussdesign, um eine nahtlose Geräteintegration, Containerintegrität, Füll-/Finish-Know-how und nachhaltige technische Leistung zu gewährleisten.

• Externe technische Aufsicht: Zusammenarbeit mit externen Partnern, die technische Aufsicht über mechanische Designs für Kombinationsprodukte bieten, um hohe Leistung, Robustheit und Innovation zu gewährleisten.

• Strukturierte Problemlösung & RCA: Führen Sie interne und externe technische Untersuchungen, lösen Sie schnell designbezogene Geräte- und Primärbehälterprobleme (z. B. Losbrech-/Gleitkraft, Glasschadensmechanismen, untersichtbare Partikel, Stopperbewegung) durch Anwendung strukturierter Problemlösungsmethoden.

• Design Control & Regulatory Authoring: Author Design Control Dokumentation (z. B. Design Development Plans, User Requirements Specifications, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, Design Verification Plans), Konformitätsbewertungen und Risikomanagement Dokumentation.

• Anwendung von Standards & Compliance: Wenden Sie Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Landschaft an, um standardkonforme Designs sicherzustellen (z. B. ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820, ISO 14971, 21 CFR 820.30, 21 CFR Part 4, ISO 11040, ISO 11608, USP <1207> / USP <381> / USP <660>).

Wer du bist:

• Universitätsabschluss (BSc oder MSc) in Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einer verwandten technischen Disziplin von einer akkreditierten Institution.

• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Maschinenbau und in der Entwicklung von Arzneimitteln in pharmazeutischen oder stark regulierten Umgebungen (cGxP, QSR).

• Starke Expertise in Behälterverschlusssystemen, insbesondere vorgefüllten Spritzen (PFS) und Kartuschen für die parenterale Arzneimittelabgabe (einschließlich CCI-Tests, Elastomer-/Beschichtungschemie, Staked-Needle-Integration und Dimensionsstapel).

• Erfahrung in Füll-/Finish-Technologie inkl. Stoppering

• Bewährte technische Führung und fortschrittliche Problemlösungsfähigkeiten in funktionsübergreifenden Teamumgebungen.

• Ein solides Verständnis der Materialwissenschaft, das auf Arzneimittelverabreichungssysteme angewendet wird, mit Expertise in Schadensmechanismen, Fehlererkennung und Leistungstests.

• Tiefes Wissen über Vorschriften, Industriestandards und Leitlinien für Kombinationsprodukte und Medizinprodukte auf globaler Ebene.

• Direkte Erfahrung beim Navigieren in Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden und beim Verwalten regulatorischer Einreichungen (einschließlich der Erstellung von Modul 3 für IND/IMPD und NDA/BLA).

• Technische Kenntnisse in der parenteralen Arzneimittelabgabe, Risikobewertung, Toleranzanalyse, statistische Techniken, Prozessfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeitstechnik zur Lösung komplexer Probleme.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, strategisches Denken und starke Dokumentations- / Präsentationsfähigkeiten, um Stakeholder effektiv zu beeinflussen.

• Für diese globale Rolle ist fließend Englisch erforderlich; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Global Technical Development (PTD) est une organisation de plus de deux mille personnes dans le monde qui font partie intégrante de la mission de Roche de développer des médicaments significatifs pour les patients. Par conséquent, nous collaborons activement et développons des solutions techniques créatives pour combler les besoins en produits commerciaux, en début de phase et en fin de phase. Le mandat est de livrer le pipeline et de fournir des produits de qualité aux patients.

Le service de développement des dispositifs de Roche Technical Development est responsable du développement et du soutien des dispositifs de livraison des médicaments pour le portefeuille de produits. Nos activités couvrent une gamme de disciplines d'ingénierie allant de la phase de définition des exigences jusqu'à la commercialisation et au soutien des produits commercialisés.

L'ingénierie des appareils combine la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la fabrication pour mettre au point des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments fiables et sécuritaires qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des fournisseurs de soins de santé et des autorités sanitaires.

L'occasion :

Ce rôle pratique stimule l'excellence en ingénierie en appliquant des contrôles de conception, en résolvant les défis complexes d'ingénierie des appareils et en fournissant des conseils techniques stratégiques pour assurer le développement et la conformité robustes des produits.
Dans ce rôle, vous participerez à une vaste collaboration interfonctionnelle, en particulier avec les équipes d'assurance de la qualité, d'affaires réglementaires, cliniques et commerciales. Ce rôle relève du chef de section de l'ingénierie des appareils et est intégré à la fonction de développement des appareils Roche.

• Servir de chef de file technique et d'expert en matière de mise en marché de produits combinés et d'instruments médicaux.

• Appliquez une expertise approfondie dans les matériaux primaires des contenants (verre de type I, polymères COP/COC, élastomères, revêtements fonctionnels) et les profils d'extractibles/de débrayables (E&L) pour établir des spécifications techniques robustes pour les systèmes d'emballage primaire.

• Élaborer et évaluer des solutions de conception de fermeture de contenants pour assurer l'intégration transparente de l'appareil, l'intégrité du contenant, l'expertise de remplissage/finition et une performance technique soutenue.

• Surveillance technique externe : Collaborer avec des partenaires externes en assurant la supervision technique des conceptions mécaniques pour les produits combinés afin d'assurer des performances élevées, la robustesse de conception et l'innovation.

• Résoudre les problèmes structurés & RCA : Diriger les enquêtes techniques internes et externes, résoudre rapidement les problèmes liés à la conception des appareils et des conteneurs primaires (p. ex., force de rupture/glide, mécanismes de détérioration du verre, particules subvisibles, mouvement du bouchon) en appliquant des méthodes structurées de résolution des problèmes.

• Contrôle de la conception et autorisation réglementaire : documentation sur le contrôle de la conception de l'auteur (p. ex. plans d'élaboration de la conception, spécifications des exigences de l'utilisateur, entrées de conception, extrants de conception, plans de vérification de la conception), évaluations de la conformité et documentation sur la gestion des risques.

• Application des normes et de la conformité : Appliquer les connaissances du paysage réglementaire pour assurer des conceptions conformes aux normes (par exemple ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820, ISO 14971, 21 CFR 820.30, 21 CFR partie 4, ISO 11040, ISO 11608, USP <1207> / USP <381> / USP <660>).

Qui vous êtes :

• Diplôme universitaire (BSc ou MSc) en génie ou dans une discipline technique connexe d'un établissement agréé.

• 5 ans et plus d'expérience en génie mécanique et en mise au point d'appareils de livraison de médicaments dans des environnements pharmaceutiques ou hautement réglementés (cGxP, QSR).

• Une solide expertise dans les systèmes de fermeture des contenants, en particulier les seringues préremplies et les cartouches pour l'administration de médicaments par voie parentérale (y compris les tests de l'ICC, l'élastomère/chimie du revêtement, l'intégration des besoins en pieu et les empilements dimensionnels).

• Expérience de la technologie de remplissage/finition avec arrêt

• Un leadership technique éprouvé et des capacités avancées de résolution de problèmes dans des environnements d'équipe interfonctionnels.

• Compréhension solide de la science des matériaux appliquée aux systèmes de livraison de médicaments, avec une expertise dans les mécanismes de dommages, l'identification des défauts et les tests de performance.

• Connaissance approfondie des règlements, des normes de l'industrie et des conseils pour les produits combinés et les dispositifs médicaux à l'échelle mondiale.

• Expérience directe de navigation des interactions entre les autorités sanitaires et de gestion des présentations réglementaires (y compris la rédaction du module 3 pour l'IND/IMPD et la NDA/BLA).

• Compétence technique en matière de prestation de médicaments par voie parentérale, d'évaluation des risques, d'analyse de tolérance, de techniques statistiques, de capacité de traitement et d'ingénierie de la fiabilité pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.

• Excellentes compétences en communication, réflexion stratégique et solides capacités de documentation et de présentation pour influencer efficacement les intervenants.

• La maîtrise de l'anglais est nécessaire pour ce rôle global; la compétence allemande est un plus.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

titleByLocale.it: Discovery Scientist – Retina Neurale & Malattia Oculare
titleByLocale.en: Discovery Scientist – Neural Retina & Ocular Disease
titleByLocale.de: Discovery Scientist – Neuronale Retina & Ocular Disease
titleByLocale.fr: Chercheur à la découverte – Rétine neuronale et maladie oculaire

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our Ophthalmology team in Basel focuses on discovering novel therapeutic approaches for major eye diseases, encompassing dry AMD/geographic atrophy and neovascular forms, as well as diabetic retinopathy, and other retinal vascular diseases. We are seeking a highly motivated Discovery Scientist with specialized expertise in the neural retina and retinal pathology, including processes such as inflammation, vascular dysfunction, ischemia, fibrosis, and neurodegeneration, to drive our early-stage drug discovery efforts.

The opportunity:

In this role, your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Target Identification & Validation: Utilize and establish advanced in vitro and in vivo models of ocular disease, and leverage available patient sample datasets to identify, validate, and characterize novel therapeutic drug targets.

• Therapeutic Approach Development: I dentify and evaluate optimal therapeutic modalities for selected targets.

• Project Leadership: Independently lead and manage drug discovery projects from target initiation through early clinical development stages (up to Phase II readiness).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with interdisciplinary teams across pRED (including bioinformatics, safety, and translational medicine) to advance pipeline programs.

• External Collaboration: Initiating and leading external collaboration projects to bolster internal efforts. Manage CRO activities, including project design, timelines, and quality of deliverables.

• Scientific Communication: Present research findings at internal decision-making meetings, author high-impact publications in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, and represent Roche at international scientific conferences.

• Discovery Lab Management: Support and coordinate safety, health, and environmental processes in the lab.

You who are:

• You hold a PhD in Biology, Neuroscience, Biochemistry, or a related life sciences discipline.

• You have completed a Postdoctoral Fellowship in Vision Research, Neural Retina, Ophthalmology, or a closely related field.

• You bring comprehensive knowledge of neural retina biology and the mechanisms underlying retinal disease pathogenesis, together with a proven track record of conducting experiments using models of ocular angiogenesis, fibrosis, inflammation, or neurodegeneration.

• You have direct hands-on experience in animal handling and/or ocular procedures, OR demonstrated expertise in developing novel 2D/3D model systems, such as organoids or organ-on-a-chip. You also bring experience in cell/tissue culture, -omics technologies, and/or basic bioinformatic tools.

• You demonstrate excellent organizational skills, rigorous record-keeping, exceptional oral and written English communication, and a strong collaborative mindset in a fast-paced environment.

• You bring 2–3 years of additional professional experience in academic or industry drug discovery settings, together with a proven track record of leading research projects and cross-functional project teams and a strong publication record in top-tier vision or scientific journals.

• You have an established professional network within the global ophthalmology research community.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il nostro team di oftalmologia a Basilea si concentra sulla scoperta di nuovi approcci terapeutici per le principali malattie oculari, che comprendono atrofia e forme neovascolari a secco, così come retinopatia diabetica e altre malattie vascolari retinali. Stiamo cercando uno scienziato altamente motivato Discovery con competenza specializzata nella retina neurale e patologia retinica, tra cui processi come l'infiammazione, disfunzione vascolare, ischemia, fibrosi e neurodegenerazione, per guidare i nostri sforzi di scoperta della droga di fase precoce.

L'opportunità:

In questo ruolo, le tue responsabilità chiave includono, ma non sono limitate a:

• Identificazione e convalida del bersaglio: Utilizzare e stabilire modelli avanzati in vitro e in vivo di malattia oculare, e sfruttare i dataset campione dei pazienti disponibili per identificare, convalidare e caratterizzare nuovi obiettivi terapeutici della droga.

• Sviluppo dell'approccio terapeutico: dentifico e valuto le modalità terapeutiche ottimali per gli obiettivi selezionati.

• Leadership del progetto: guidare e gestire in modo indipendente i progetti di scoperta della droga dall'avvio del bersaglio attraverso le prime fasi di sviluppo clinico (fino alla prontezza della fase II).

• Collaborazione interdisciplinare: Partner con team interdisciplinari attraverso pRED (compresa la bioinformatica, la sicurezza e la medicina traduttiva) per avanzare programmi di pipeline.

• Collaborazione esterna: avviare e condurre progetti di collaborazione esterna per rafforzare gli sforzi interni. Gestisci le attività CRO, tra cui la progettazione del progetto, le linee temporali e la qualità dei prodotti.

• Comunicazione scientifica: I risultati attuali della ricerca in riunioni decisionali interne, autore di pubblicazioni ad alto impatto in riviste peer-reviewed di alto livello, e rappresentano Roche in conferenze scientifiche internazionali.

• Discovery Lab Management: Supporto e coordinate di sicurezza, salute e processi ambientali in laboratorio.

Voi che siete:

• Hai un dottorato in Biologia, Neuroscienze, Biochimica, o una disciplina relativa delle scienze della vita.

• Hai completato una Fellowship Postdoctoral in Vision Research, Neural Retina, Ophthalmology, o un campo strettamente correlato.

• Porti una conoscenza completa della biologia della retina neurale e dei meccanismi che stanno alla base della patogenesi della malattia retina, insieme ad una comprovata traccia di esperimenti con modelli di angiogenesi oculare, fibrosi, infiammazione o neurodegenerazione.

• Hai un'esperienza diretta nella gestione degli animali e/o nelle procedure oculari, O dimostrato esperienza nello sviluppo di nuovi sistemi di modelli 2D/3D, come organoidi o organ-on-a-chip. Porti anche l'esperienza nella cultura cellulare/materiale, tecnologie -omics e/o strumenti bioinformatici di base.

• Lei dimostra eccellenti capacità organizzative, scritture discografiche rigorose, eccezionale comunicazione orale e scritta inglese, e una forte mentalità collaborativa in un ambiente frenetico.

• Porti 2–3 anni di esperienza professionale aggiuntiva in ambienti di scoperta di farmaci accademici o di settore, insieme a un comprovato track record di progetti di ricerca e team di progetto interfunzionali e un forte record di pubblicazione in top-tier vision o riviste scientifiche.

• Hai una rete professionale consolidata all'interno della comunità globale di ricerca di oftalmologia.

A Roche, ci proponiamo di offrire soluzioni sanitarie in continuo cambiamento. Se siete pronti a fare un impatto significativo su pazienti e sistemi sanitari in tutto il mondo, questo è il posto per voi.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our Ophthalmology team in Basel focuses on discovering novel therapeutic approaches for major eye diseases, encompassing dry AMD/geographic atrophy and neovascular forms, as well as diabetic retinopathy, and other retinal vascular diseases. We are seeking a highly motivated Discovery Scientist with specialized expertise in the neural retina and retinal pathology, including processes such as inflammation, vascular dysfunction, ischemia, fibrosis, and neurodegeneration, to drive our early-stage drug discovery efforts.

The opportunity:

In this role, your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Target Identification & Validation: Utilize and establish advanced in vitro and in vivo models of ocular disease, and leverage available patient sample datasets to identify, validate, and characterize novel therapeutic drug targets.

• Therapeutic Approach Development: I dentify and evaluate optimal therapeutic modalities for selected targets.

• Project Leadership: Independently lead and manage drug discovery projects from target initiation through early clinical development stages (up to Phase II readiness).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with interdisciplinary teams across pRED (including bioinformatics, safety, and translational medicine) to advance pipeline programs.

• External Collaboration: Initiating and leading external collaboration projects to bolster internal efforts. Manage CRO activities, including project design, timelines, and quality of deliverables.

• Scientific Communication: Present research findings at internal decision-making meetings, author high-impact publications in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, and represent Roche at international scientific conferences.

• Discovery Lab Management: Support and coordinate safety, health, and environmental processes in the lab.

You who are:

• You hold a PhD in Biology, Neuroscience, Biochemistry, or a related life sciences discipline.

• You have completed a Postdoctoral Fellowship in Vision Research, Neural Retina, Ophthalmology, or a closely related field.

• You bring comprehensive knowledge of neural retina biology and the mechanisms underlying retinal disease pathogenesis, together with a proven track record of conducting experiments using models of ocular angiogenesis, fibrosis, inflammation, or neurodegeneration.

• You have direct hands-on experience in animal handling and/or ocular procedures, OR demonstrated expertise in developing novel 2D/3D model systems, such as organoids or organ-on-a-chip. You also bring experience in cell/tissue culture, -omics technologies, and/or basic bioinformatic tools.

• You demonstrate excellent organizational skills, rigorous record-keeping, exceptional oral and written English communication, and a strong collaborative mindset in a fast-paced environment.

• You bring 2–3 years of additional professional experience in academic or industry drug discovery settings, together with a proven track record of leading research projects and cross-functional project teams and a strong publication record in top-tier vision or scientific journals.

• You have an established professional network within the global ophthalmology research community.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Unser Ophthalmologie-Team in Basel konzentriert sich auf die Entdeckung neuer therapeutischer Ansätze für schwere Augenkrankheiten, darunter trockene AMD / geographische Atrophie und neovaskuläre Formen sowie diabetische Retinopathie und andere retinale Gefäßerkrankungen. Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Discovery Scientist mit spezialisiertem Fachwissen in der neuronalen Netzhaut und Netzhautpathologie, einschließlich Prozessen wie Entzündungen, vaskulärer Dysfunktion, Ischämie, Fibrose und Neurodegeneration, um unsere Bemühungen im Frühstadium der Wirkstoffforschung voranzutreiben.

Die Gelegenheit:

In dieser Rolle umfassen Ihre Hauptaufgaben, sind aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• Zielidentifizierung und -validierung: Verwenden und etablieren Sie fortschrittliche In-vitro- und In-vivo-Modelle von Augenerkrankungen und nutzen Sie verfügbare Patientenprobendatensätze, um neue therapeutische Wirkstoffziele zu identifizieren, zu validieren und zu charakterisieren.

• Therapeutische Ansatzentwicklung: Ich dentify und bewerten optimale therapeutische Modalitäten für ausgewählte Ziele.

• Projektleitung: Unabhängige Leitung und Verwaltung von Wirkstoffforschungsprojekten von der Zielinitiierung bis zu frühen klinischen Entwicklungsphasen (bis zur Phase-II-Bereitschaft).

• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Partnerschaft mit interdisziplinären Teams in pRED (einschließlich Bioinformatik, Sicherheit und translationale Medizin), um Pipeline-Programme voranzutreiben.

• Externe Zusammenarbeit: Initiierung und Leitung externer Kooperationsprojekte zur Stärkung interner Bemühungen. Verwalten Sie CRO-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Projektdesign, Zeitpläne und Qualität der Ergebnisse.

• Wissenschaftliche Kommunikation: Präsentieren Sie Forschungsergebnisse auf internen Entscheidungssitzungen, schreiben Sie einflussreiche Publikationen in erstklassigen, von Experten begutachteten Fachzeitschriften und vertreten Sie Roche auf internationalen wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen.

• Discovery Lab Management: Unterstützung und Koordination von Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltprozessen im Labor.

Sie, die

• Sie haben einen PhD in Biologie, Neurowissenschaften, Biochemie oder einer verwandten Life-Science-Disziplin.

• Sie haben ein Postdoc-Stipendium in Vision Research, neuronaler Retina, Augenheilkunde oder einem eng verwandten Bereich abgeschlossen.

• Sie bringen umfassende Kenntnisse der neuronalen Netzhautbiologie und der Mechanismen, die der Pathogenese von Netzhauterkrankungen zugrunde liegen, zusammen mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Durchführung von Experimenten mit Modellen der Augenangiogenese, Fibrose, Entzündung oder Neurodegeneration.

• Sie haben direkte praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Tieren und / oder Augenverfahren oder haben Fachwissen in der Entwicklung neuartiger 2D / 3D-Modellsysteme wie Organoide oder Organ-on-a-Chip gezeigt. Sie bringen auch Erfahrung in Zell- / Gewebekultur, -omik-Technologien und / oder grundlegende bioinformatische Werkzeuge mit.

• Sie zeigen hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten, strenge Aufzeichnungen, außergewöhnliche mündliche und schriftliche englische Kommunikation und eine starke kollaborative Denkweise in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung.

• Sie bringen 2-3 Jahre zusätzliche Berufserfahrung in akademischen oder industriellen Drug Discovery-Einstellungen mit, zusammen mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz von führenden Forschungsprojekten und funktionsübergreifenden Projektteams und einer starken Publikationsbilanz in erstklassigen Visionen oder wissenschaftlichen Zeitschriften.

• Sie haben ein etabliertes professionelles Netzwerk innerhalb der globalen ophthalmologischen Forschungsgemeinschaft.

Bei Roche wollen wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern. Wenn Sie bereit sind, einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf Patienten und Gesundheitssysteme weltweit zu haben, ist dies der richtige Ort für Sie.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit engagieren sich
